"""One finding's Markdown section, and the two entry points that call it.""" from __future__ import annotations import logging from vvaharness.models.scan._render import ( _code_span, _confidence_label, _demote_md_headings, _md_cell, _one_line, _render_repro_block, _snippet_fence, _vector_span, ) from vvaharness.models.scan.findings import RankedFinding from vvaharness.models.vocab import OFFENSIVE_LABELS log = logging.getLogger(__name__) log = logging.getLogger(__name__) # Reader labels only, wire ev_status unchanged; EV is positive-only, so CONFIRMED is its one verdict _EV_VERDICT_LABEL = { "CONFIRMED": "CONFIRMED (beta)", "NOT_CONFIRMED": "NOT CONFIRMED (beta)", "INCONCLUSIVE": "REQUIRES REVIEW (beta)", "NOT_TESTED": "SAST-ONLY (beta; not live-testable)", } # Names the `Why:` source: a routing fact and a model's reading read alike but are not equal _EV_REASON_TAG = { "rule": "[rule] ", "triage": "[triage] ", "judge": "[judge] ", } # Restated on every non-confirmed block: the block is where the misreading happens. _EV_NOT_A_FP_NOTE = ("_Not a false positive: exploit verification only ever adds a live " "confirmation. This finding's verdict comes from static " "verification._") # The same point beside the run-level tally. _EV_POSITIVE_ONLY_NOTE = ("Exploit verification is additive and positive-only: a finding " "it did not confirm live is not a false positive — the static " "verifier owns that verdict.") def finding_section_lines(i: int, rf: RankedFinding) -> list[str]: """The Markdown lines of one finding's report section (1-based index *i*).""" return [line for line, _ in _finding_section(i, rf)] def finding_description_lines(i: int, rf: RankedFinding) -> list[str]: """The section lines tagged for the SARIF ``description`` property.""" return [line for line, keep in _finding_section(i, rf) if keep] def _finding_section(i: int, rf: RankedFinding) -> list[tuple[str, bool]]: """One finding's rendered section as ``(line, in_sarif_description)`` pairs.""" f = rf.finding if f.cvss_score is not None: # A FALSE_POSITIVE means the score was computed against a rejected claim, so it misleads _score = ("(scored against the claim, verdict FALSE_POSITIVE)" if f.verdict == "FALSE_POSITIVE" else f"**{f.cvss_score:.1f}**") cvss = f"{_score} ({f.cvss_rating}) — {_vector_span(f.cvss_vector)}" elif f.cvss_vector: cvss = _vector_span(f.cvss_vector) else: cvss = "_not computed_" from vvaharness.report.cwe import cwe_for, cwe_name _cwe = cwe_for(f.cwe, f.vuln_class) _nm = cwe_name(_cwe) if _cwe else "" _cwe_label = (f"{_cwe}: {_nm}" if _nm else _cwe) if _cwe else "" out = [ (f"### {i}. [{rf.severity.value.upper()}] {_md_cell(f.title)}", False), (f"**Class:** {_cwe_label or f.vuln_class.value}", False), ] if _cwe: _n = _cwe.split('-')[-1] out.append( (f"**CWE:** {_cwe_label} - " f"https://cwe.mitre.org/data/definitions/{_n}.html", False)) # Repo-controlled path: folding backticks to U+02CB is the only way it cannot close the span _file_span = _md_cell(f.file).replace(chr(96), chr(0x2CB)) # A line_end of 0 renders as a bare start line, never a bogus `path:42-0` range. _lines = (f"{f.line_start}-{f.line_end}" if f.line_end else f"{f.line_start}") out.extend([ (f"**File:** `{_file_span}:{_lines}`", False), # Pinned by tests: only a "_not computed_" CVSS line enters the description. (f"**CVSS 3.1:** {cvss}", cvss == "_not computed_"), ]) if f.vsvs_score is not None: out.append((f"**VulContextSeverity:** `{f.vsvs_vector}` - " f"**{f.vsvs_score:.1f} ({f.vsvs_rating})**", False)) if f.offensive_priority: out.append((f"**OffensivePriority:** **{f.offensive_priority}** - " f"{OFFENSIVE_LABELS.get(f.offensive_priority, '')} | " f"*{_md_cell(f.offensive_reason)}*", False)) if f.duplicates: # Model-authored paths: fold backticks or one could close the code span. refs = ", ".join( f"`{_md_cell(d.file).replace(chr(96), chr(0x2CB))}:{d.line_start}" + (f"-{d.line_end}`" if d.line_end and d.line_end != d.line_start else "`") for d in f.duplicates ) out.append((f"**Also at:** {refs}", False)) out.append(("", True)) if f.duplicates: out.extend([ ((f"*{len(f.duplicates)} additional call site(s) collapsed " f"during dedup — same root cause; each location needs the " f"same fix applied.*"), True), ("", True), ]) # Model prose: escape angles or GFM acts on an /

# Reader labels only, wire ev_status unchanged; EV is positive-only, so CONFIRMED is its one verdict
# Names the `Why:` source: a routing fact and a model's reading read alike but are not equal
# Restated on every non-confirmed block: the block is where the misreading happens.
# The same point beside the run-level tally.
# A FALSE_POSITIVE means the score was computed against a rejected claim, so it misleads
# Repo-controlled path: folding backticks to U+02CB is the only way it cannot close the span
# A line_end of 0 renders as a bare start line, never a bogus `path:42-0` range.
# Pinned by tests: only a "_not computed_" CVSS line enters the description.
# Model-authored paths: fold backticks or one could close the code span.
# Model prose: escape angles or GFM acts on an /
# Snippet stays raw, so the fence must outrun any backtick run inside or it forges structure
# Fold, not demote: a multi-line value spills raw lines below the label
# Only ev_status None is skipped; "**Exploit Verification:**" is the line MD consumers key on
# Folded to one line: the parsers read a labelled line as a unit.
# Pinned by tests: the heading enters the description though its lines are MD-only.
# "EV Confidence", not bare "Confidence": a static "**Confidence:**" line already exists
# A confirmation's evidence is the proof, so it rides the verdict line.
# Non-confirming: the reason is the whole message, so it gets its own labelled line
# Method/CVSS/repro describe HOW it confirmed, so only CONFIRMED carries them
# Advisory only: static cvss_score owns ranking, hence the "EV CVSS" label
# _code_span, not a bare pair: a backtick closes the span, a fold corrupts it
# Verbatim output: only blank lines OUTSIDE <details> enter the SARIF description
